title: Lightly Toasted Brazilian Chicken Skewers
description: A herbal and crunchy Brazilian dish featuring hojicha and mantecare emulsify, perfect for a hangover cure, served on a hot stone plate
instructions: Preheat the hot stone plate to 400 degrees Fahrenheit
In a large bowl, whisk together hojicha powder, coconut oil, mantecare emulsify, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and paprika
Add the chicken breast pieces to the bowl and toss to coat evenly
Thread the chicken pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece
Place the skewers on the hot stone plate and cook for 10 minutes, flipping halfway through
Reduce the heat to 350 degrees Fahrenheit and cook for an additional 5 minutes
Remove the skewers from the heat and let rest for 2 minutes
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired
